# telnyx_terms_of_service_branded_calling_agree (Action)

Agrees to the Branded Calling Terms of Service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Agree to the Branded Calling terms once. Needs Terraform 1.14 or later:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.telnyx_terms_of_service_branded_calling_agree.this
action "telnyx_terms_of_service_branded_calling_agree" "this" {}
```
